newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit falls as dollar surges against yen.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit falls as dollar surges against yen.

text.p: The ringgit fell as the surge of the dollar against the yen brought out sellers in the Malaysian currency, dealers said.
The ringgit started on a weak note after falling below a key technical support at 2.4920 a dollar.
"Dollar/yen broke 120. In other days, players would be sceptical but today the dollar was very bullish," said a dealer at a Malaysian bank.
By late Tokyo, dollar had hit a high of 120.13 yen, just a whisper below last Friday's 47-month high of 120.20 yen.
At the 0900 GMT Kuala Lumpur close, ringgit was at 2.4927/37 a dollar against 2.4892/02 previously.
Dealers said the ringgit's immediate fortune is tied to dollar/yen movements, though medium-term sentiment support gains for the Malaysian currency.
The ringgit has made strong gains this year as Malaysia's high interest rates attracted foreign funds.
